summary: The documents describe the functionality and implementation details of the CriminalRecordsCheckEditAll user control component in a web application. The control handles the display, editing, and validation of criminal record check information for students.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing and editing criminal record check data related to student enrollments.

Register JavaScript variables for client-side use.

Update student details based on changes.
Redirect based on command execution results.
